metadata.title: Identifying students’ solution strategies in digital mathematics assessment using log data

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study uses estimated ability scores obtained via Warm’s WLE, which does not involve multiple plausible values or Rubin's rules.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights in the analysis of the student-level data.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual students' data without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using bootstrap procedures for model robustness but does not validate findings on external datasets or different contexts.
